title: GorillaDesk Pricing 2026: Per-Route Cost, Plans & Fees
description: GorillaDesk costs $49-$149/mo for the first route with unlimited users. Added-route prices, 1-10 route totals, SMS fees and trial terms, checked Nov 1, 2026.
h1: GorillaDesk pricing: what each plan and route really costs
body:
Looking up the GorillaDesk price? Every number below comes from GorillaDesk's own pricing page, checked on 2026-11-01. Prices are in USD per month. GorillaDesk is priced per route, not per user, so the useful question is how many routes you run, not how many people log in. Anything GorillaDesk doesn't publish is marked unknown.

GorillaDesk plans and prices (2026)

There are three plans. Each includes unlimited admin, manager, sales and crew users. The price is for your first route, and every added route costs extra:

PlanFirst routeEach added routeUnlimited users
Basic$49/moRoutes 2-3: +$50/mo each. Route 4 and up: +$30/mo eachYes
Pro$99/mo+$50/mo per added routeYes
Growth$149/moRoute 2: +$100/mo. Route 3 and up: +$50/mo eachYes

GorillaDesk also sells an annual subscription, billed for the whole year up front, but it doesn't publish the annual price or any annual discount, so that's unknown.

What is a "route" in GorillaDesk?

GorillaDesk uses "route" and "schedule" to mean the same thing. A route is one technician schedule. GorillaDesk's rule of thumb:

  • Techs who ride solo each need their own route.
  • Crews that ride together share one route, so you only assign routes to crew leaders or supervisors.

Only users assigned to a schedule count toward the price. Office staff, managers and extra crew members are free on every plan.

We calculated these totals from the per-route prices above. The 1-, 3- and 5-route totals match the worked examples on GorillaDesk's pricing page.

What GorillaDesk costs per year

These are monthly list prices × 12, before SMS credits and card processing fees:

  • 1 route: $588/yr on Basic, $1,188/yr on Pro, $1,788/yr on Growth.
  • 3 routes: $1,788/yr on Basic, $2,388/yr on Pro, $3,588/yr on Growth.
  • 5 routes: $2,508/yr on Basic, $3,588/yr on Pro, $4,788/yr on Growth.

What each plan includes

From the feature lists on GorillaDesk's pricing page (2026-11-01):

  • Basic: unlimited users and mobile devices, unlimited email/phone/chat support, invoices, estimates and work orders, advanced invoice frequencies, job and customer mapping, basic routing (up to 25 stops at a time), Square and Stripe payments, broadcast email and SMS, note and to-do templates, material tracking and reporting (chemical use records), triggered automations, automated reminders and late-payment messages, and 20 built-in reports.
  • Pro adds: a customer portal, online booking, Stripe and Square subscription billing, Drive Matrix routing (real-time street routing and drive times), review requests, documents and e-signatures, custom documents, device tracking and barcoding (traps and equipment, with trend reporting), multi-dwelling units, production and sales commission tracking, QuickBooks Online sync, GPS tracking, email inbox sync, Zapier, open API access and time clocking.
  • Growth adds: map measuring tools for estimates, drive time on schedules, Best Available Time suggestions, Job Magnet, dynamic estimates and estimate packages, a sales pipeline with opportunities and reporting, Smart Views, custom fields, custom job statuses and multi-branch support.

Rule of thumb from the feature list: Basic covers scheduling, invoicing and chemical records. Pro is the cheapest plan with QuickBooks Online sync, online booking, a customer portal and routing beyond 25 stops. Growth adds sales tools and multi-branch support.

Extra fees: SMS, card processing and setup

  • Texting: $5/mo for the SMS subscription (a local number that forwards to your main line), plus prepaid credits: $50 for 1,000 texts, $100 for 2,500 or $200 for 8,000. Credits never expire and are only used for outgoing texts. The page's summary also mentions a $20 pack but doesn't say how many texts it includes (unknown).
  • Card payments: processed through Stripe or Square at their rates. GorillaDesk doesn't list a markup of its own, so any extra fee is unknown.
  • Setup and data migration: no setup fees. GorillaDesk's team imports contact details, service and billing addresses, notes and a starting balance for free. It can't import full past service or billing history.
  • Custom documents: no extra charge, per the pricing page.

Contract, cancellation and free trial

  • Free trial: 14 days. No credit card needed.
  • Monthly: no contract, cancel any time without penalty.
  • Seasonal businesses: you can freeze the account instead of cancelling.
  • Annual: billed for the full year at the start. To add a route mid-term, you contact Customer Success.
  • Plan changes: upgrade any time. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

Is GorillaDesk cheaper than Jobber, Housecall Pro or Skimmer?

It depends on how many people log in compared with how many routes you run:

  • Solo operator: GorillaDesk Basic is $49/mo. Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually or $49/mo with no commitment (checked 2026-10-31). Core doesn't include routing or QuickBooks sync. GorillaDesk Basic has basic routing but no QuickBooks sync. See Jobber pricing.
  • 5 techs on separate routes: GorillaDesk is $209/mo on Basic or $299/mo on Pro. Jobber's 5-user Connect is $149/mo billed annually ($199 with no commitment), and Housecall Pro Essentials (5 users) is $149/mo billed annually (both checked 2026-10-31). Per-user tools win here. See Housecall Pro pricing.
  • Crews riding together, or lots of office users: GorillaDesk wins. Two 3-person crews are 2 routes, which is $99/mo on Basic or $149/mo on Pro with no charge for the other 4 people or for office staff. Per-user tools charge for every login.
  • Pool routes: Skimmer charges $1 per serviced location with a $49/mo minimum (checked 2026-10-30), and Pool Brain charges $50/mo plus $65/mo per field tech (checked 2026-10-27). See Skimmer pricing.

faq: How much does GorillaDesk cost per month?

As of 2026-11-01, GorillaDesk's pricing page lists Basic at $49/mo, Pro at $99/mo and Growth at $149/mo for the first route, with unlimited users on every plan. Added routes cost extra: Basic +$50/mo each for routes 2-3 and +$30/mo from route 4, Pro +$50/mo per route, and Growth +$100/mo for route 2 and +$50/mo from route 3.
No. GorillaDesk charges per route (schedule). Admin, manager, sales and crew users are unlimited and free on every plan. Only users assigned to a schedule count toward the price.
Does GorillaDesk have a free trial?
Yes. GorillaDesk lists a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
Does GorillaDesk have contracts or setup fees?

No. Monthly plans have no contract and no setup fees, you can cancel any time, and seasonal businesses can freeze the account. An annual subscription is also available and is billed for the full year up front, but its price isn't published.
How much does GorillaDesk texting cost?
The SMS subscription is $5/mo, plus prepaid credits: $50 for 1,000 texts, $100 for 2,500 or $200 for 8,000. Credits never expire and are only used for outgoing texts.
QuickBooks Online sync starts on Pro ($99/mo for the first route). Basic doesn't include it.
What does GorillaDesk cost for 5 routes?
Based on the published per-route prices, 5 routes cost $209/mo on Basic, $299/mo on Pro and $399/mo on Growth. Those totals match GorillaDesk's own worked examples.
